2608.23393.abstract: KellyBoost is a single multi-output XGBoost model whose softmax output is the portfolio: with y the vector of per-asset holding-period returns, the training loss is - log(1 + w y), the negative log growth rate, so the fitted model is the growth-optimal (Kelly) allocation conditioned on the features. The objective is exact rather than a surrogate: we derive the gradient, the analytic diagonal Hessian and the full Hessian in closed form, verify them by finite differences, and ship a dependency-free reference engine.

bullets: Splitting return forecasts from sizing loses optimality
Softmax output is the portfolio; loss is -log(1 + w y)
Closed-form gradient and Hessian, checked by finite differences
Ships a dependency-free reference engine
en.data: Theory and implementation only; the abstract names no dataset or test window.
en.method: One multi-output XGBoost trained on the exact negative log-growth objective.
en.one_liner: Swaps XGBoost's loss for Kelly log-growth so the model outputs weights directly.
en.relevance_why: Data is just per-asset holding-period returns, so sourcing is trivial, but you still design the universe, rebalance cadence and leverage caps yourself.
en.takeaway: Use it to collapse the predict-then-optimize pipeline into a single fitted allocator.

bullets: 수익률 예측과 비중 결정을 나누면 최적성이 깨진다
소프트맥스 출력을 비중으로 두고 -log(1+wy)를 최소화한다
그래디언트와 헤시안을 닫힌 형태로 유도해 유한차분으로 검증한다
의존성 없는 참조 엔진을 함께 공개한다
ko.data: 이론과 구현 중심이며 초록에 데이터셋이나 검증 구간은 없다.
ko.method: 다중 출력 XGBoost 한 개에 켈리 로그성장률 손실을 직접 넣어 학습한다.
ko.one_liner: XGBoost 손실함수를 켈리 성장률로 바꿔 비중을 직접 뽑는다.
ko.relevance_why: 데이터는 자산별 수익률이면 충분해 확보가 쉽지만, 종목 유니버스와 리밸런싱 주기, 레버리지 제약을 직접 설계해야 한다.
ko.takeaway: 예측 모델의 출력을 비중으로 바꾸는 단계를 없애고 싶을 때 쓴다.

2608.23393.title: KellyBoost: Growth-Optimal Portfolio Construction with Gradient-Boosted Trees

2608.23416.abstract: Systematic trading rests on one article of faith: that regularities found in the past persist. We state it as a time-invariant mechanism driven by an unobserved latent state, and show that it leaves a researcher five constants to declare --- the recurrence bound $Lambda$ at a block length $b$, the invariance defect $epsilon_0$ of the representation it is declared of, the coherence times $ell_i$ of the state's coordinates, the signal ceiling $rho$ and the fraction $kappa$ of it contingent on the regime --- after which the architecture of a correct quantitative investment system is nearly forced.

bullets: Traders assume past regularities persist, never stating it
Formalizes it as a time-invariant latent-state mechanism
Derives five constants: Lambda, epsilon_0, ell_i, rho, kappa
Fixing them nearly forces the system architecture
en.data: Theory only
en.method: A time-invariant mechanism driven by an unobserved latent state, reduced to a recurrence bound, an invariance defect, coherence times, a signal ceiling, and a regime-contingent fraction.
en.one_liner: Li axiomatizes systematic trading into five constants a researcher must declare.
en.relevance_why: Pure theory with no dataset or backtest, so nothing is tradable as written; +1 for an original framing of system design.
en.takeaway: Use it as a pre-build checklist: write down your block length, signal ceiling, and regime-dependent share before coding a strategy.

bullets: 과거 규칙성이 지속된다는 믿음을 방치해 온 문제
관측 불가능한 잠재 상태가 끄는 시불변 메커니즘으로 정식화
연구자가 선언할 다섯 상수를 도출해 구조를 강제
상수를 정하면 올바른 투자 시스템 설계가 거의 결정된다
ko.data: 이론 연구
ko.method: 잠재 상태 기반 시불변 메커니즘을 세우고 재현 한계, 불변성 결손, 좌표별 결맞음 시간, 신호 상한, 국면 의존 비율을 도출한다.
ko.one_liner: 시스템 트레이딩의 전제를 다섯 상수로 공리화한 이론 논문이다.
ko.relevance_why: 데이터가 아예 없는 순수 이론이라 백테스트로 옮길 규칙이 없지만, 설계 원칙의 독창성으로 1점을 더했다.
ko.takeaway: 전략 설계 전에 블록 길이, 신호 상한, 국면 의존 비율을 명시적으로 적어 두는 체크리스트로 쓴다.

2608.23416.title: The Axiomatic Trader: Latent Regularity, Information Budgets, and the Canonical Form of a Quantitative Investment System

2608.23576.abstract: We characterise minimum-distortion wealth taxation under two contrasting normative criteria within a Fokker-Planck framework on log-wealth: the JKO free-energy gap, an information-theoretic measure aligned with the Mirrleesian decision-distortion tradition, and the squared 2-Wasserstein distance from the no-tax distribution at horizon $T$, a transport-geometric measure aligned with the Saez-Zucman distributional-compression tradition. Restricting to the neutrality-preserving (C1)-(C3) schedule class of a companion paper (Froseth 2026), both optima admit closed forms in the two-dimensional design plane parametrised by the corporate-dividend retention $k = (1-τ_c)(1-τ_d)$ and the proportional wealth-tax rate $τ_w$. The JKO optimum partitions the regime axis into three phases as a function of the dimensionless ratio $ρ= Σ_0 m_0/σ^2$, with $m_0 = μ- σ^2/2$ the geometric mean log-return: a pure wealth-tax phase at low $ρ$, a mixed-instrument phase at intermediate $ρ$, and a pure flow-tax phase at high $ρ$. The $W_2$ optimum, by contrast, is degenerate in this calibration: it pins to the pure flow-tax corner across the whole regime axis. The criterion contrast admits an economically meaningful reading via a bluntness index $B(m_0) = b/(a m_0)$ that measures the wealth-tax channel's mean-displacement-per-revenue overshoot relative to the flow-tax channel; JKO weights $B$ linearly, $W_2$ weights it quadratically, and the two normative traditions correspond to this difference in weighting. Norwegian-flavoured calibrations sit inside the JKO mixed-instrument phase under stock-heavy portfolio volatility but move into the pure flow-tax phase under the realised effective volatility of typical real-estate-heavy households.
2608.23576.comment: 41 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. Companion paper to arXiv:2603.05264, arXiv:2603.05277, arXiv:2603.05283, and arXiv:2607.06153

bullets: Two normative traditions disagree on measuring tax distortion
Fokker-Planck diffusion on log-wealth, two optimality metrics
JKO splits into 3 phases; W2 collapses to flow-tax corner
Bluntness index B: JKO weights it linearly, W2 quadratically
en.data: Theory only, with illustrative Norwegian-style tax calibrations.
en.method: Minimises the JKO free-energy gap and the squared 2-Wasserstein distance over a two-parameter tax design plane.
en.one_liner: Derives closed-form optimal wealth-tax schedules under two rival distortion criteria.
en.relevance_why: Pure tax-policy theory with no tradable rule; inputs are statutory tax parameters, not market data, so it scores 1.
en.takeaway: At most a reference for after-tax compounding models or Norwegian household capital-flow scenarios.

bullets: 부유세 왜곡을 재는 규범적 기준이 서로 갈린다
로그 자산에 포커-플랑크 방정식을 세워 푼다
JKO는 3구간, W2는 유량세 코너로 붕괴한다
노르웨이 보정값은 포트폴리오 변동성에 따라 갈린다
ko.data: 이론 연구다. 다만 노르웨이 세제를 본뜬 보정값을 예시로 쓴다.
ko.method: 로그 자산의 포커-플랑크 확산 위에서 JKO 자유에너지 격차와 2-바서슈타인(2-Wasserstein) 거리를 각각 최소화한다.
ko.one_liner: 부유세 최적 설계를 두 가지 최적성 기준으로 비교한 이론 논문이다.
ko.relevance_why: 조세 정책 이론이라 자동화할 규칙이 없고, 필요한 데이터도 시장 데이터가 아닌 세제 파라미터라 1점이다.
ko.takeaway: 거래 신호로 쓸 건 없고, 세후 복리 수익 모형이나 노르웨이 자산가 자금 흐름 시나리오 정도에 참고한다.

2608.23576.title: Minimum-Distortion Wealth Taxation, I: Information-Theoretic versus Transport-Geometric Optimality on the Proportional Class

2608.24449.abstract: We show that the key optimization results of the classical Markowitz portfolio selection theory, originally formulated for variance as the risk measure, remain available in explicit closed form under a broader class of strictly convex quadratic risk measures. The proposed framework replaces the covariance matrix with an arbitrary symmetric positive definite matrix and allows additional linear and constant terms, thereby containing various models arising in transaction cost optimization, benchmark relative optimization, covariance regularization, and factor models. Closed-form formulas are obtained for the efficient frontier, the global minimum risk portfolio, the maximum Sharpe ratio portfolio, the Capital Market Curve, the tangency portfolio, and the maximum utility portfolio. In contrast to the classical Markowitz model, the tangency portfolio does not coincide with the maximum Sharpe ratio portfolio, revealing a new geometric phenomenon. A numerical example confirms the derived formulas.

bullets: Variance-only risk excludes transaction costs and benchmark-relative goals
Swap covariance for any symmetric positive definite matrix, add linear and constant terms
Closed forms for efficient frontier, min-risk, max-Sharpe, tangency, max-utility portfolios
Tangency portfolio no longer equals the max-Sharpe portfolio
en.data: Theory only; one numerical example checks the formulas.
en.method: Strictly convex quadratic objective solved analytically under budget and return constraints.
en.one_liner: The authors extend Markowitz optimization to any strictly convex quadratic risk measure, in closed form.
en.relevance_why: Only standard price data is needed, but this is a portfolio-construction framework, not a signal, so a strategy still needs substantial design.
en.takeaway: Fold turnover costs or tracking error straight into the risk term and rebalance with an analytic solution.

bullets: 분산만 위험으로 쓰는 마코위츠 틀은 거래비용·벤치마크를 못 담는다
공분산행렬을 임의의 대칭 양정부호 행렬로 바꾸고 선형·상수항을 더한다
효율적 경계, 최소위험·최대샤프·접점 포트폴리오를 모두 닫힌 식으로 얻는다
접점 포트폴리오가 최대 샤프 포트폴리오와 더는 일치하지 않는다
ko.data: 이론 연구이며 수치 예제 하나로 공식을 확인한다.
ko.method: 위험을 강볼록 이차형식으로 두고 라그랑주 방식으로 해를 유도한다.
ko.one_liner: 마코위츠 최적화를 일반 이차 위험척도로 확장해 닫힌 해를 구한다.
ko.relevance_why: 데이터는 가격만 있으면 되지만 신호가 아닌 최적화 틀이라 전략화에 설계가 더 필요하다.
ko.takeaway: 거래비용이나 벤치마크 추적오차를 위험함수에 직접 넣고 해석해로 리밸런싱한다.

2608.24449.title: Generalizing Markowitz Portfolio Optimization by a Quadratic Risk Measure

2608.26106.abstract: We study statistical predictability in daily U.S. equity prices using only information available at the market open. Using SPY from February 1, 1993 through March 15, 2024, we benchmark XGBoost against Random Forest, LightGBM, Logistic Regression, and naive baselines under expanding-window walk-forward validation. After observing the current day's opening price and two lagged target-specific prices, the task is to predict whether the same day's close will be above or below the previous day's close. On the last 800 trading days, Logistic Regression attains the highest close-direction accuracy (71.09%), Random Forest reaches 61.20%, and XGBoost reaches 58.45% with a 95% bootstrap confidence interval of [54.94%, 62.08]. For XGBoost, close-direction accuracy rises to 72.7% when the predicted move exceeds 1%, but the usable sample falls to 154 observations. We also report Diebold-Mariano and McNemar tests, regime-specific results, SHAP feature importance, and an auxiliary 541-equity screen. The evidence supports a narrow statistical-finance conclusion: simple daily equity features contain detectable same-day directional information, but the result should be interpreted with careful sample-size accounting and limited economic claims.

bullets: Asks if open-only information forecasts the same-day close direction
Expanding-window walk-forward pits five models against naive baselines
Over the last 800 days: Logistic 71.09%, RF 61.20%, XGBoost 58.45%
XGBoost hits 72.7% when predicted move exceeds 1%, but n drops to 154
en.data: SPY daily bars, 1 Feb 1993 to 15 Mar 2024, evaluated on the final 800 trading days.
en.method: XGBoost, Random Forest, LightGBM and Logistic Regression on the open plus two lagged prices.
en.one_liner: The author tests whether open-price features predict SPY's same-day close direction.
en.relevance_why: Free daily bars make it trivially reproducible, but no entry, exit or cost rules means real strategy design remains.
en.takeaway: Use it as a starting point for an open-to-close directional filter, trading only high-magnitude signals.

bullets: 장 시작 정보만으로 당일 종가 방향을 맞힐 수 있는지 묻는다
확장 윈도(expanding window) 워크포워드로 5개 모델을 비교한다
최근 800일에서 로지스틱 회귀 71.09%, 랜덤 포레스트 61.20%
XGBoost는 58.45%지만 예측 변동폭 1% 초과 구간에선 72.7%
ko.data: SPY 일봉 1993년 2월 1일~2024년 3월 15일, 검증은 마지막 800거래일 중심이다
ko.method: XGBoost, 랜덤 포레스트, LightGBM, 로지스틱 회귀를 순진한 기준선과 함께 겨룬다
ko.one_liner: 당일 시가만으로 종가 방향을 맞히는 모델을 SPY로 검증한다
ko.relevance_why: 데이터는 무료 일봉이라 재현이 쉽지만, 진입·청산 규칙과 비용 가정이 없어 전략화에 설계가 더 필요하다
ko.takeaway: 시가 갭 기반 당일 청산 신호의 출발점으로 쓰되, 예측 변동폭이 큰 구간만 걸러 매매한다

2608.26106.title: A Statistical-Finance Benchmark for Same-Day Directional Stock Prediction: Walk-Forward Evidence from SPY

2608.26115.abstract: We re-estimate canonical option-implied predictability evidence using a unified 2015--2026 panel of 12.36 million U.S. equity firm-day observations across 10,026 underlyings. We split the sample into three regimes: late-post-crisis low volatility (2015--2019), high-volatility transition (2020--2022), and AI/mega-cap concentration (2023--2026). The Xing et al. (2010) smirk--return relationship weakens steadily: the next-month univariate smirk coefficient falls from $-0.023$ $(t=-5.5)$ in 2015--2019 to an insignificant $-0.006$ $(t=-1.5)$ in 2023--2026, and turns positive at the three-month horizon $(+0.016,\ t=+2.1)$. In joint specifications with all six canonical signals, the smirk is insignificant throughout and again changes sign in the latest regime. By contrast, the Cremers--Weinbaum IV spread and a Bakshi et al. (2003)-style risk-neutral skewness measure remain significant across regimes and specifications. A boosted-tree benchmark using IV-surface, trading-activity, Greeks, and liquidity features outperforms linear models for next-month return prediction only in the AI/mega-cap regime, with $R^2_{\mathrm{OOS}}=+1.29%$ versus $+0.07%$. Permutation importance identifies different leading predictors by regime, and no canonical hand-engineered signal enters the top five. For firm-level five-day crash classification, AUC is highest in calm markets $(0.706,\ \text{XGBoost})$ and lowest during the high-volatility transition $(0.561)$. Overall, option-implied predictability is real but regime-dependent, and the post-2023 AI/mega-cap period differs sharply from the pre-COVID setting in which the canonical results were established.

bullets: Canonical smirk results were established pre-COVID; do they still hold?
Splits 12.36M firm-days into three regimes, runs OLS plus boosted trees
Smirk decays to -0.006 (t=-1.5) and flips positive at 3 months
IV spread and risk-neutral skewness stay significant everywhere
en.data: 12.36M U.S. equity firm-day observations, 10,026 underlyings, 2015-2026, split into 2015-19, 2020-22 and 2023-26.
en.method: Univariate and joint regressions on six option signals, plus XGBoost on IV-surface, Greeks, activity and liquidity features.
en.one_liner: Re-tests six canonical option-implied signals across three market regimes, 2015-2026.
en.relevance_why: Signals are precisely defined and reproducible, but historical U.S. option chains are a paid vendor feed, so 4 not 5.
en.takeaway: Drop the smirk, keep Cremers-Weinbaum IV spread and risk-neutral skew, and gate any ML overlay on a regime detector.

bullets: 코로나 이전에 세운 정설이 지금도 통하는지 다시 검증한다
2015~2026년을 세 국면으로 쪼개 회귀와 부스팅 트리를 돌린다
스머크는 힘을 잃고 IV 스프레드와 위험중립 왜도는 살아남는다
AI·초대형주 국면에서만 트리 모델이 선형 모델을 이긴다
ko.data: 미국 주식 옵션 10,026개 종목, 1,236만 기업-일 관측치를 2015~2026년 세 국면으로 나눠 검증한다.
ko.method: 여섯 개 표준 옵션 신호를 회귀로 비교하고 XGBoost로 수익률과 급락을 예측한다.
ko.one_liner: 옵션 시장 예측력이 시기마다 달라진다는 사실을 대규모 패널로 확인했다.
ko.relevance_why: 신호 정의가 명확해 바로 구현할 수 있지만, 미국 옵션 체인 이력 데이터를 유료로 사야 해 4점이다.
ko.takeaway: 스머크 대신 IV 스프레드와 위험중립 왜도를 알파 신호로 쓰고, 국면 판별 장치를 반드시 붙인다.

2608.26115.title: Option-Implied Signals and Crash Risk: Predictability and Machine-Learning Evidence from U.S. Equity Options

2608.26122.abstract: This article examines various methods of constructingmultidimensional probabilistic forecasts of electricity prices. Building on the Multiple Split (MS) method, it incorporates forecast averaging across estimation windows of different lengths and compares its performance with that of other, well-established methods. The research demonstrates that the ensemble representation of the price distribution is particularly useful in battery energy storage system (BESS) management. It enables the direct construction of probabilistic forecasts of daily profits. These forecasts can be used to determine optimal charging and discharging hours, as well as to support risk management decisions. The methods are evaluated using data from the German and Spanish day-ahead electricity markets from 2021-2024. The results indicate that theMS method with averaging (MS-ave) generally outperforms the other considered approaches in terms of Prediction Interval Coverage Probability (PICP), the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) and the Energy Score (ES). Moreover, it is superior in supporting BESS trading strategies, particularly in case of non-zero operational costs.

bullets: Point forecasts miss the 24-hour joint price structure
Multiple Split method plus averaging over estimation windows
MS-ave wins on PICP, CRPS and Energy Score
Edge is largest once operational costs are non-zero
en.data: German and Spanish day-ahead electricity markets, 2021-2024.
en.method: Multiple Split (MS) ensemble with forecast averaging across estimation windows of different lengths.
en.one_liner: Weron and Maciejowska forecast the joint distribution of hourly power prices and turn it into a distribution of daily BESS profits.
en.relevance_why: Charge/discharge rules fall straight out of the profit distribution, but battery specs and cost assumptions are yours to set; European day-ahead prices are free from ENTSO-E.
en.takeaway: Feed the price ensemble into a storage optimizer to pick charge and discharge hours and size the risk of each day's trade.

bullets: 일중 24시간 가격의 결합분포를 제대로 잡는 방법이 부족하다
Multiple Split(MS)에 추정창 길이별 예측 평균을 더한다
MS-ave가 PICP·CRPS·에너지 스코어 모두에서 앞선다
운영비용이 0이 아닐 때 매매 전략 지원 효과가 특히 크다
ko.data: 독일·스페인 하루전(day-ahead) 전력시장의 2021~2024년 가격 자료로 검증한다.
ko.method: 다중 분할(Multiple Split) 기법에 서로 다른 추정창 길이의 예측을 평균해 앙상블 가격분포를 만든다.
ko.one_liner: 전력 가격의 다차원 확률예측으로 배터리 저장장치 매매 수익을 직접 예측한다.
ko.relevance_why: 충·방전 규칙을 수익 분포에서 바로 도출하지만 배터리 사양과 비용 가정은 직접 정해야 하며, 유럽 하루전 가격은 ENTSO-E에서 무료로 받는다.
ko.takeaway: 앙상블 시나리오를 그대로 넣어 일일 수익 분포를 뽑고, 충·방전 시각 선택과 리스크 한도 설정에 쓴다.

2608.26122.title: From electricity prices to profits: multidimensional probabilistic forecasting for BESS trading

2608.26127.abstract: Accurate forecasting of realized volatility ($RV$) is crucial for risk management and derivatives pricing. Although the implied volatility ($IV$) surface offers rich informational content, prevailing methods that treat it as a static image fail to capture its inherent dynamics. To overcome this limitation, we propose the Finance-Aware Graph Spatio-Temporal Network (FA-GSTN), a novel architecture that reframes $RV$ forecasting as modeling the evolution of a structured financial object. FA-GSTN builds a spatio-temporal graph sequence from the $IV$ surface, where nodes correspond to grid points and edges encode adaptive spatial (intra-day) and explicit temporal (inter-day) dependencies. The model incorporates domain knowledge through finance-aware node features (e.g., option Greeks) and tackles high-frequency noise via a multi-scale temporal smoothing gate coupled with an adaptive robust loss function. Comprehensive evaluations on a large-scale equity options dataset show that FA-GSTN sets a new state of the art, delivering superior predictive accuracy ($R^2$ up to 0.473). It also demonstrates remarkable data efficiency, substantially outperforming strong Vision Transformer baselines when trained on only one year of data ($R^2$: 0.372 vs. 0.315). Furthermore, the model exhibits enhanced robustness during periods of market stress, such as 2020--2021. Ablation studies confirm the vital roles of the spatio-temporal graph structure, finance-aware components, and integrated noise-handling modules. Our work underscores the substantial benefits of explicitly modeling temporal dynamics and infusing financial inductive biases for accurate and robust volatility forecasting.

bullets: Prior methods freeze the IV surface into a static image
FA-GSTN turns grid points into spatio-temporal graph nodes
Greeks as features, smoothing gate for high-frequency noise
R² up to 0.473; 0.372 vs 0.315 on one year of data
en.data: Large-scale equity options dataset, including the 2020-2021 stress period.
en.method: A spatio-temporal graph net with adaptive intra-day edges, explicit inter-day edges, and a robust loss.
en.one_liner: The authors forecast realized volatility by modeling the IV surface as an evolving graph.
en.relevance_why: Scored 3 because IV surfaces and Greeks need paid options data, and the forecast still needs a trading rule built around it.
en.takeaway: Feed the RV forecast into option vol hedging or delta-hedge rebalancing frequency.

bullets: 기존 방식은 IV 표면을 정지 이미지로만 다룬다
격자점을 노드로 삼아 시공간 그래프를 만든다
옵션 그릭스와 잡음 제거 모듈을 함께 넣는다
R² 0.473으로 최고 성능을 찍었다
ko.data: 대규모 주식 옵션 데이터로 검증했고, 2020~2021년 시장 충격 구간에서도 성능을 유지한다
ko.method: FA-GSTN은 IV 표면의 격자점을 노드로 잇고, 일중 공간 연결과 일간 시간 연결을 학습한다
ko.one_liner: 내재변동성 표면을 그래프로 바꿔 실현변동성을 예측한다
ko.relevance_why: IV 표면과 그릭스는 유료 옵션 데이터가 필요하고, 예측치를 매매 규칙으로 바꾸려면 별도 설계가 더 든다
ko.takeaway: 옵션 포지션의 변동성 리스크 헤지나 델타 헤지 빈도 조절에 예측치를 넣어 쓴다

2608.26127.title: Graph-Based Modeling of Financial Volatility Dynamics

2608.26128.abstract: This thesis analyzes the collective dynamics of the S&P 500 from an econophysics perspective, treating the financial market as a complex system. Using daily logarithmic returns of 430 companies, time-dependent Pearson correlation matrices are constructed over sliding windows and their spectral structure is studied through the leading eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Market States (MS) are identified by applying k-Means clustering to several spectral quantities: the largest eigenvalue (interpreted as the State of the Market), the squared entries of the dominant eigenvector (read as a relative participation of each stock), and truncated matrix reconstructions C^l built from the l largest eigenpairs and normalized to retain a correlation-matrix interpretation. The stability of the resulting clusters is assessed, transition matrices and their stationary vectors are computed, and the inverse participation ratio is used to quantify how participation spreads across assets. The COVID-19 episode emerges as an atypical state in the full correlation matrices; reconstructing it requires more than one principal component, and the C^2 and C^3 constructions reproduce it, particularly for window length q=40 and k=5. During crisis periods the relative participation distributes over a larger number of assets, while the 2017-2018 interval contributes to the dynamics without appearing as an isolated regime. The analysis is descriptive rather than predictive, and provides conceptual and methodological tools relevant to portfolio design and trading strategies, with natural extensions to other international exchanges.
2608.26128.comment: 72 pages, 40 figures, 9 tables. Undergraduate (Licenciatura) thesis, Facultad de Ciencias, UNAM, 2026. Original Spanish version in the UNAM thesis repository (TESIUNAM, record 0881908)

bullets: Treats the market as a complex system, not single names
k-Means on eigenvalues and dominant-eigenvector weights
COVID needs 2-3 components; C^2, C^3 reproduce it
Crises spread participation across more stocks
en.data: Daily log returns of 430 S&P 500 companies, with the COVID-19 episode and the 2017-2018 interval as focus periods.
en.method: Builds sliding-window Pearson correlation matrices, then k-Means clusters the top eigenvalue, squared dominant-eigenvector entries, and truncated reconstructions C^l.
en.one_liner: Clusters S&P 500 correlation spectra into market states.
en.relevance_why: Data is trivial to source (daily closes), but the author calls the work descriptive, not predictive, so entry and exit rules need building from scratch.
en.takeaway: Use the state transition matrix and inverse participation ratio as a regime switch for sizing and diversification.

bullets: 시장을 복잡계로 보고 집단 동학을 파악하려 한다
이동창 상관행렬의 고유값·고유벡터를 클러스터링한다
코로나 국면은 주성분 2~3개를 써야 재현된다
위기 때는 참여도가 더 많은 종목으로 퍼진다
ko.data: S&P 500 편입 430개 종목의 일간 로그수익률을 쓰고, 코로나 구간과 2017~2018년 구간을 살핀다.
ko.method: 이동창 피어슨 상관행렬에서 최대 고유값과 주고유벡터, 절단 재구성 행렬 C^l을 뽑아 k-평균(k-Means)으로 시장 국면을 나눈다.
ko.one_liner: S&P 500 상관행렬의 주성분으로 시장 국면을 나눈다.
ko.relevance_why: 데이터는 일간 종가만 있으면 되어 확보가 쉽지만, 논문 스스로 예측이 아닌 서술적 분석이라 밝혀 매매 규칙까지는 추가 설계가 필요하다.
ko.takeaway: 국면 전이행렬과 역참여비율(IPR)을 리스크 스위치로 삼아 위기 국면에서 분산 비중을 조정한다.

2608.26128.title: Analysis of the Principal Components of Correlation Matrices of S&P 500 Financial Data from an Econophysics Perspective

2608.26158.abstract: This paper provides a controlled comparison of six information bar types (dollar, volume, volatility, range, Renko, and hybrid bars) constructed from both raw Binance aggTrade tick data and one-minute OHLCV bars for the BTCUSDT USDT-margined perpetual futures market over a six-year period spanning January 2020 to December 2025, and evaluated against fixed-interval time-bar baselines. Both pipelines share a common adaptive EMA calibration framework; the tick pipeline additionally uses strictly tick-native activity signals, isolating data resolution as the sole experimental variable. Results across eight statistical quality criteria reveal that the tick advantage is bar-type-specific and most pronounced in bar types whose activity signals are most sensitive to intra-minute price dynamics: tick Renko bars achieve the smallest random-walk deviation recorded ($|\mathrm{VR}(4){-}1| = 0.020$, lag-1 autocorrelation $= 0.002$), and tick volatility bars reduce serial dependence by 69\% relative to the minute baseline ($|\mathrm{VR}(4){-}1|: 0.028$ versus $0.089$). In the multi-regime six-year sample, normality improvements are regime-dependent and secondary: the extreme market events of 2020--2022 inflate fat tails across all bar types, and Ljung-Box independence is rejected for all series at the sample sizes studied. A matched-frequency robustness analysis shows that the apparent tick underperformance on distributional criteria is largely a sampling-frequency artefact: when tick series are coarsened to the minute pipeline's bar count, frequency-matched tick dollar bars lead on all six criteria and matched tick volatility bars attain LB $p = 0.51$, recovering serial independence that the raw oversampled series rejects.

bullets: Nobody had isolated data resolution as the only variable in bar construction
Same adaptive EMA calibration on dollar, volume, volatility, range, Renko, hybrid bars
Tick Renko hits |VR(4)-1| = 0.020; tick volatility bars cut serial dependence 69%
Frequency-matched tick dollar bars win all six criteria; volatility bars reach LB p = 0.51
en.data: Binance BTCUSDT USDT-margined perpetual futures, aggTrade ticks and 1-minute OHLCV, Jan 2020 to Dec 2025.
en.method: Adaptive EMA threshold calibration builds six bar types, scored on eight statistical quality criteria.
en.one_liner: The authors compare six information bar types built from ticks versus one-minute bars.
en.relevance_why: Binance tick data is free to download, but the paper gives features and sampling advice, not trading rules.
en.takeaway: Pick tick Renko or tick volatility bars as strategy inputs, and match bar counts before comparing.

bullets: 정보바를 만들 때 틱 데이터가 정말 필요한지 불분명하다
달러·거래량·변동성·레인지·렌코·하이브리드 6종을 같은 EMA 보정으로 생성한다
틱 렌코바가 VR(4) 편차 0.020으로 최저, 틱 변동성바는 계열상관을 69% 줄인다
빈도를 맞추면 틱 달러바가 6개 기준 전부 우위, 변동성바 LB p=0.51까지 회복한다
ko.data: 바이낸스 BTCUSDT 무기한 선물의 aggTrade 틱과 1분 OHLCV, 2020년 1월~2025년 12월
ko.method: 적응형 EMA로 임계값을 보정해 정보바 6종을 만들고 통계 품질 8개 기준으로 평가한다
ko.one_liner: 틱과 1분봉으로 만든 정보바 6종을 같은 조건에서 비교한다
ko.relevance_why: 바이낸스 틱 데이터는 무료 공개라 데이터 확보는 쉽지만, 매매 규칙이 없어 특징 생성 단계에 머문다
ko.takeaway: 전략 입력 바를 고를 때 틱 렌코·변동성바를 쓰고, 바 개수를 맞춘 뒤 성능을 비교한다

2608.26158.title: A Frequency-Controlled Comparison of Tick- and Minute-Based Information Bars for Cryptocurrency Markets

2608.26174.abstract: Bitcoin's future fluctuations are a substantial concern for investments and risk management. Investors and financial institutions require accurate forecasts of these price movements to hedge and optimize portfolios. This study aims to answer the question of whether Bitcoin's price will rise beyond 5% within the next 7 days by utilizing on-chain, market, and sentiment data from February 2018 to December 2025. The proposed model consists of a multi-scale temporal convolutional network with InceptionTCN blocks, CNN channel attention, adaptive average pooling, and a pairwise ranking loss. Dilated convolutions with bottleneck and fusion layers are employed to efficiently capture features over horizons from 1 to 4 days. Given the class imbalance in the dataset, AUC is used instead of accuracy and other classification metrics to reflect the model's performance better. Subsequently, a profit-optimized decision threshold is also applied to align model selection with financial objectives. The proposed model is compared with 5 other baselines: ImprovedTCN_GRU, LSTM, TCN, XGBoost, and Random Forest. Results indicate that the proposed model achieved an AUC of 0.6316 and a profit of 1.703, outperforming all baseline models. Using a novel deep learning model would assist investors in making better financial decisions.

bullets: Targets economically meaningful jumps, not raw price levels
Multi-scale TCN with channel attention and ranking loss
AUC 0.6316 and profit 1.703 beat all five baselines
Uses AUC over accuracy because classes are imbalanced
en.data: On-chain, market, and sentiment data for Bitcoin from February 2018 to December 2025.
en.method: A multi-scale temporal convolutional network with InceptionTCN blocks, CNN channel attention, adaptive average pooling, and pairwise ranking loss.
en.one_liner: The authors predict whether Bitcoin rises over 5% within 7 days.
en.relevance_why: On-chain and price data are easy to source, but the sentiment inputs are unspecified and no entry/exit rules are given, so a tradable version needs real design work.
en.takeaway: Steal the profit-optimized threshold step: pick cutoffs by PnL, not by F1, on any classifier signal.

bullets: 가격 예측 대신 경제적으로 유의미한 급등만 겨냥한다
다중 스케일 TCN에 채널 어텐션과 랭킹 손실을 결합한다
AUC 0.6316, 수익 1.703으로 baseline 5종을 모두 앞선다
불균형 데이터라 정확도 대신 AUC로 평가한다
ko.data: 2018년 2월부터 2025년 12월까지 비트코인 온체인·시장·심리 데이터를 쓴다.
ko.method: InceptionTCN 블록, CNN 채널 어텐션, 적응형 평균 풀링, 쌍별 랭킹 손실을 쓴 다중 스케일 시간 합성곱망이다.
ko.one_liner: 온체인·시장·심리 데이터로 비트코인 7일 5% 상승을 예측한다.
ko.relevance_why: 온체인·가격 데이터는 구하기 쉽지만 심리 지표 출처와 진입·청산 규칙이 빠져 있어 재현에 추가 설계가 필요하다.
ko.takeaway: 수익 기준으로 임계값을 고르는 방식은 다른 분류형 신호에도 그대로 옮겨 쓸 만하다.

2608.26174.title: Forecasting Economically Significant Bitcoin Moves: A Multi-Scale TCN with Profit-Optimized Thresholds

2608.27076.abstract: Algorithmic trading now represents a market exceeding $20 billion, where even marginal gains in signal robustness can translate into economically significant returns. Existing evaluations of equity prediction models do not explicitly target regime robustness during hyperparameter selection. Five model classes are trained on daily observations from approximately 300 large-cap US equities over eleven years, with Bayesian optimisation configured to target trading performance across three statistically different market regimes. Regime-robust hyperparameter selection is associated with out-of-sample generalisation, as signal precision remains above the random baseline across all four quarters of the test period, and portfolio performance slowly degrades under simulated input noise before collapsing beyond a defined threshold. No individual tabular deep learning architecture outperforms gradient-boosted trees, but combining XGBoost and TabNet using rank aggregation produces a Hybrid ensemble with an annualised return of 51.26%, a Sharpe ratio of 2.44, and a statistically significant CAPM alpha of 0.423 (p = 0.011). A near-zero beta indicates this outperformance is driven by stock selection, not market exposure. Alternative data plays a secondary role once technical and fundamental features are accounted for, as well as contributing more strongly on the short side than the long, and varies by model class. An interactive application makes these results explorable in real time, with live data integration the remaining step toward practical deployment.

bullets: Standard tuning ignores regime robustness in model selection
Bayesian optimisation targets returns across three regimes
Hybrid ensemble: 51.26% annual, 2.44 Sharpe, 0.423 alpha
Near-zero beta: gains come from selection, not exposure
en.data: Daily bars for ~300 US large-cap stocks over eleven years, tested across four out-of-sample quarters.
en.method: Five model classes tuned by Bayesian optimisation on regime-split trading metrics; XGBoost and TabNet merged by rank aggregation.
en.one_liner: Tunes equity models for cross-regime trading performance, then ensembles XGBoost with TabNet.
en.relevance_why: Prices and fundamentals are cheap and the recipe is reproducible, but alternative-data features and exact entry/exit rules are left to you.
en.takeaway: Swap your tuning objective to regime-split trading performance, and rank-blend a boosted tree with a tabular net.

bullets: 기존 평가는 하이퍼파라미터 단계에서 국면 강건성을 안 본다
통계적으로 다른 3개 국면의 매매 성과를 목표로 튜닝한다
하이브리드 앙상블이 연 51.26%, 샤프 2.44, 알파 0.423
베타가 0에 가까워 초과수익은 종목 선택에서 나온다
ko.data: 미국 대형주 약 300종목의 11년치 일간 데이터를 쓰고 테스트 구간 4개 분기로 검증한다.
ko.method: 5개 모델을 국면별 매매 성과로 튜닝하고 XGBoost와 TabNet을 순위 합산으로 묶는다.
ko.one_liner: 국면별 베이지안 최적화로 주식 신호를 뽑고 XGBoost·TabNet을 앙상블한다.
ko.relevance_why: 가격·재무 데이터는 구하기 쉽고 방법도 재현 가능하지만, 대체 데이터와 세부 진입·청산 규칙은 직접 설계해야 한다.
ko.takeaway: 단일 딥러닝 모델 대신 부스팅 트리와 순위 앙상블을 쓰고, 튜닝 목적함수를 국면별 성과로 바꿔 쓴다.

2608.27076.title: Tabular Deep Learning for Algorithmic Trading: Cross-Regime Bayesian Optimisation for Equity Signal Generation

2608.27734.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to discover trading strategies, and much of the resulting literature shares a methodological weakness: many candidate strategies are generated, the best is reported, and neither look-ahead bias nor the intensity of the search behind the reported result is corrected for. We present a strategy-discovery system that makes both corrections structural rather than procedural. First, the agent can only act through registry-validated tools whose feature space excludes look-ahead by construction; we show that this guardrail is not redundant with statistical correction: a deliberately leaky oracle posting a Sharpe ratio of 35 survives Deflated Sharpe and probability-of-backtest-overfitting testing completely. Second, the system records every strategy evaluation its search performs and deflates all reported performance by that trial count, tracing how the best in-sample Sharpe ratio climbs with each trial while the deflation threshold, driven by the agent's own search, climbs faster. Across a 453-stock point-in-time US equity universe and a 39-ETF multi-asset universe with realistic transaction, impact, and borrow costs, honest evaluation certifies passive benchmarks (out-of-sample confidence intervals excluding zero), rejects every LLM-discovered strategy (across two frontier models, search budgets up to one hundred candidates, and five repeated runs), catching selection luck, predicted rank degradation, and out-of-sample collapse through complementary instruments, and evaluates a human trader's production rule system under identical instruments. The framework formalizes why pre-registered hypotheses earn lower evidential bars than brute search, and quantifies the sample sizes that credible certification of moderate edges actually requires.

bullets: LLM strategy papers report the best candidate, hiding search intensity
Registry-validated tools block look-ahead; trial counts deflate results
A leaky oracle at Sharpe 35 passes DSR and PBO completely
Passive benchmarks certify; all LLM strategies fail across 2 models, 5 runs
en.data: 453-stock point-in-time US equity universe and a 39-ETF multi-asset universe, with transaction, impact, and borrow costs.
en.method: An agent acts only through registry-validated tools with a look-ahead-free feature space, and every evaluation is logged to deflate Sharpe ratios by trial count.
en.one_liner: Honest evaluation rejects every LLM-discovered strategy the authors tested.
en.relevance_why: Scored 3: it delivers validation machinery, not tradable rules, though the point-in-time price data it needs is easy to source.
en.takeaway: Bolt trial-count logging and a rising deflation threshold onto your own research pipeline as a go/no-go gate.

bullets: LLM 전략 논문은 최선 결과만 보고하고 탐색 횟수를 숨긴다
미래참조를 구조적으로 막은 도구만 쓰게 하고 시행 횟수로 디플레이션한다
샤프 35짜리 누출 전략이 DSR·PBO를 완전히 통과해 통계 보정만으론 부족하다
패시브 벤치마크는 통과, LLM 전략은 두 모델·5회 반복에서 전멸이다
ko.data: 시점 정합(point-in-time) 미국 주식 453종목과 39개 ETF 멀티에셋 유니버스에 거래·시장충격·차입 비용을 반영해 검증했다.
ko.method: 레지스트리 검증 도구로 특징 공간을 제한하고, 모든 평가 횟수를 기록해 디플레이티드 샤프(Deflated Sharpe)와 백테스트 과최적화 확률(PBO)로 성과를 깎는다.
ko.one_liner: LLM이 찾아낸 전략은 정직한 검증을 하나도 통과하지 못한다
ko.relevance_why: 매매 규칙이 아니라 검증 프레임워크라 3점이며, 필요한 데이터는 시점 정합 주가 정도라 확보 난이도는 낮은 편이다.
ko.takeaway: 자체 전략 탐색 파이프라인에 시행 횟수 기록과 디플레이션 문턱값을 붙여, 리서치 결과를 자동으로 걸러내는 게이트로 쓴다.

2608.27734.title: What survives honest evaluation? Leakage-safe, search-aware assessment of LLM-driven trading strategy discovery

2608.28399.abstract: In financial markets, a sequential policy that reacts systematically to price movements may become predictable to other market participants. This paper studies whether large language model (LLM) agents exhibit such directional structure through RetailAgent, an experimental framework in which an LLM observes anonymized intraday equity price histories and permitted state, then repeatedly chooses long (hold the stock) or flat (stay out) before the subsequent interval return is revealed. We compare returns during long and flat intervals along the same stock's intraday path after removing the overall fraction of long decisions. This exposure-matched measure reveals persistent negative timing across modality, horizon, state, and model family. Shuffling saved action sequences substantially attenuates the effect, showing that alignment between actions and subsequent returns drives the negative score. Feeding self-authored memories into decisions further increases policy persistence, while timing becomes more negative among stock-days on which the agent uses both actions. These results reveal stable, recoverable directional structure in sequential LLM financial decisions and a behavioral signal for studying how another participant could respond to a predictable policy.

bullets: Asks whether LLM agent policies carry exploitable directional structure
LLM sees anonymized intraday prices, picks long or flat each interval
Exposure-matched timing stays negative across models, horizons, states
Shuffling the action sequence kills the effect, so alignment drives it
en.data: Anonymized intraday equity price paths; the abstract names no tickers, sample size, or date range.
en.method: RetailAgent feeds anonymized intraday price histories plus allowed state to multimodal LLMs that repeatedly choose long or flat.
en.one_liner: LLM trading agents systematically pick the wrong intervals to hold stock.
en.relevance_why: Intraday prices are easy to get, but the paper gives no tradable rule and reproducing it needs undisclosed prompts plus real LLM inference cost.
en.takeaway: Treat it as a starting point for fading predictable LLM-agent flow, not as a signal to trade directly.

bullets: LLM 에이전트의 매매 결정에 예측 가능한 방향성이 있는지 묻는다
익명 처리한 장중 가격을 주고 롱/현금을 반복 선택하게 한다
롱 비중을 맞춰 비교하니 타이밍 점수가 계속 마이너스다
행동 순서를 섞으면 효과가 크게 줄어 정렬이 원인임을 보인다
ko.data: 익명 처리한 개별 종목의 장중 가격 이력을 쓰지만, 종목·기간·표본 규모는 초록에 없다.
ko.method: RetailAgent라는 실험 틀에서 멀티모달 LLM에 장중 가격 이력과 상태를 주고 롱/현금을 반복 선택시킨다.
ko.one_liner: LLM 매매 에이전트가 구조적으로 나쁜 타이밍을 반복한다는 사실을 밝힌다.
ko.relevance_why: 장중 가격은 구하기 쉽지만 LLM 추론 비용과 미공개 프롬프트·종목 구성 탓에 재현이 어렵고, 매매 규칙 자체가 없어 2점이다.
ko.takeaway: LLM 에이전트를 신호원으로 쓰기보다, 상대편 에이전트의 예측 가능한 패턴을 역이용하는 연구 출발점으로 삼는다.

2608.28399.title: RetailAgent: Structured Adverse Timing in Self-Conditioned Multimodal LLM Trading Agents

2608.29025.abstract: Classical option-hedging methods like Black-Scholes delta assume constant, free rebalancing, which real markets don't allow. Deep hedging trains a neural network to handle these frictions directly, and prior work reports strong results. But those comparisons usually pit deep hedging against a frictionless classical baseline on simulated price data. That's not a fair fight, and it leaves open whether the advantage is real. We test this using five years of actual BTC options data from Deribit (2020-2024), comparing Black-Scholes delta, Leland's cost-adjusted hedge, and the Whalley-Wilmott no-trade band against three deep hedging setups: an LSTM and a feedforward network, each trained with a CVaR loss and, in some runs, a penalty for trading too often. All six strategies face the same 5 basis point transaction cost. On 11,546 test episodes from September 2023 to December 2024, Whalley-Wilmott cuts transaction costs significantly versus hourly rebalancing, saving $1.79 per episode against plain BS delta (95% CI [-2.21, -1.39], p < 0.0001) by trading about eight times less often. Its P&L and tail-risk numbers are better too, though not quite significant at this sample size. None of the three deep hedging models beat any classical benchmark on any metric, and all kept trading almost every hour regardless of penalty weight, a twenty-fold range barely moved the needle. A calmer validation period shows Whalley-Wilmott's P&L edge shrinks or disappears there while its cost edge holds, so the result depends on market regime. We think the likely causes are a small training set and the lack of any built-in mechanism for sitting still in the architectures tested. Not a flashy result, but an honest one: a real-data check on a claim mostly supported by simulations so far.

bullets: Prior wins came from simulations and frictionless baselines
LSTM and MLP trained on CVaR loss, all at 5bp costs
No deep hedging model beat any classical benchmark
Whalley-Wilmott saved $1.79 per episode, traded 8x less
en.data: Deribit BTC options, 2020-2024, tested on 11,546 episodes from September 2023 to December 2024.
en.method: Black-Scholes delta, Leland's cost-adjusted hedge and the Whalley-Wilmott no-trade band race an LSTM and a feedforward net trained on CVaR loss with a trading-frequency penalty.
en.one_liner: Deep hedging loses to classical hedges on five years of real BTC options.
en.relevance_why: Deribit option data is available via public API and commercial archives, and all three classical rules are fully specified, so this backtests as written; the deep-hedging refutation earns a bonus.
en.takeaway: Bolt a Whalley-Wilmott no-trade band onto hourly delta hedging to cut costs; skip the neural net.

bullets: 딥헤징 우위는 시뮬레이션과 무마찰 벤치마크에서만 나왔다
LSTM·MLP를 CVaR 손실로 학습해 고전 헤지 셋과 붙였다
딥헤징 3종이 모든 지표에서 고전 벤치마크에 밀렸다
Whalley-Wilmott는 거래를 8배 줄여 에피소드당 $1.79 절감
ko.data: Deribit의 2020~2024년 BTC 옵션 5년치를 쓰고 2023년 9월~2024년 12월 11,546개 에피소드로 검증했다.
ko.method: 블랙-숄즈 델타, Leland 비용조정 헤지, Whalley-Wilmott 무거래 밴드를 LSTM·피드포워드 딥헤징(CVaR 손실, 거래빈도 페널티)과 5bp 동일 거래비용에서 비교했다.
ko.one_liner: 실제 BTC 옵션 데이터에서 딥헤징이 고전 헤지에 전부 졌다.
ko.relevance_why: Deribit 옵션 데이터는 공개 API와 상용 아카이브로 구할 수 있고 세 벤치마크 모두 규칙이 명시돼 바로 백테스트할 수 있다. 딥헤징 무용론이라는 반증 결과라 가점을 줬다.
ko.takeaway: 옵션 델타헤지 비용을 줄이려면 딥헤징 대신 Whalley-Wilmott 무거래 밴드를 시간당 리밸런싱 위에 얹는 게 낫다.

2608.29025.title: Deep Hedging Under Realistic Market Frictions: A Regime-Conditional Empirical Study of Dynamic Option Hedging on Bitcoin Options

2608.29468.abstract: We study the quadratic tracking problem of a general stochastic target process with absolutely continuous controls, with and without terminal constraint. We derive explicit, non-asymptotic upper bounds in terms of a Besov-type modulus of the target. These bounds yield sharp explicit rates that specialize to the square-root order for semimartingale targets. We then apply these results to a generalized Obizhaeva--Wang execution model with random terminal inventory. We first develop a Hilbert-space approach to characterize its optimal strategy, which includes jumps. To avoid such trading spikes, one regularizes the problem by a quadratic trading-rate penalty with coefficient $\varepsilon$. We then show that the regularized optimal execution cost---and therefore the excess price impact cost of the regularized optimal strategy---converges at the sharp rate $O(\sqrt{\varepsilon})$. Since the regularized optimal strategy is not available in closed form, we further construct a nearly optimal strategy which is readily implementable and shares the same approximation rate.

bullets: Smoothing away trading spikes costs money; nobody quantified it
Non-asymptotic bounds via a Besov-type modulus of the target
Regularization penalty ε costs O(√ε); a closed-form proxy matches it
en.data: theory only
en.method: Hilbert-space characterization of quadratic tracking with absolutely continuous controls, applied to a generalized Obizhaeva-Wang model with random terminal inventory.
en.one_liner: Proves regularized optimal execution costs converge at rate O(√ε).
en.relevance_why: Scored 3 because the inputs are your own fills and impact estimates — easy to source — but the paper gives a cost bound and a proxy strategy, not a ready execution schedule.
en.takeaway: Sizing the trading-rate penalty in a VWAP or inventory-tracking execution algo, with a known cost for the smoothing you buy.

bullets: 체결 스파이크를 없애려면 규제화가 필요한데 그 대가를 몰랐다
목표 추종 문제의 비점근 상한을 베소프 계량으로 유도했다
규제화 비용은 O(√ε), 준최적 전략도 같은 속도다
ko.data: 이론 연구
ko.method: 힐베르트 공간 기법으로 확률적 목표 추종의 이차 문제를 풀고 오비자에바-왕(Obizhaeva-Wang) 모형에 적용한다.
ko.one_liner: 최적 집행에서 규제화 오차가 O(√ε)로 줄어듦을 증명했다.
ko.relevance_why: 필요한 데이터는 자기 주문과 체결 기록뿐이라 확보가 쉽지만 실제 집행기로 만들려면 충격 파라미터 추정과 스케줄 설계를 따로 해야 해서 3점이다.
ko.takeaway: VWAP나 재고 목표를 따라가는 집행 알고에서 체결 속도 페널티 ε를 얼마나 키워야 비용이 얼마나 늘어나는지 계산할 때 쓴다.

2608.29468.title: The Convergence Rate of Stochastic Tracking with Application to Optimal Execution

2608.29669.abstract: Spatial return models take the interaction matrix as given and leave feedback uninterpreted. We construct a bandwidth-free field from firms' language-model article embedding distributions using target-anchored Wasserstein barycentric reconstruction. A quadratic exposure-adjustment problem maps feedback into a peer-misalignment penalty ratio. For 52 firms, the field, frozen from 2018-2022 news, yields a 2023-2026 penalty ratio of 3.46 (95% interval [2.89, 4.17]) and higher conditional quasi-likelihood than equal-weighted peer support or RBF weighting of the same distances. Joint penalty ratios for the barycentric and news co-mention fields are 2.33 and 0.86 with boundary calibrated tests which reject both exclusions.

bullets: Spatial return models take the interaction matrix as given
Wasserstein barycentric reconstruction of article embeddings
2023-2026 penalty ratio 3.46, 95% interval [2.89, 4.17]
Beats equal-weighted and RBF peer weights on quasi-likelihood
en.data: News articles for 52 firms; the field is frozen on 2018-2022 data and evaluated on 2023-2026.
en.method: Target-anchored Wasserstein barycentric reconstruction of language-model article embedding distributions, with a quadratic exposure-adjustment problem converting feedback into a peer-misalignment penalty ratio.
en.one_liner: Builds a firm interaction matrix from news embedding distributions instead of assuming one.
en.relevance_why: Scored 2 because it needs firm-level news text plus an embedding pipeline — costly to source — and 52 firms with no entry or exit rules leaves heavy design work.
en.takeaway: Replace hand-set peer weights in a risk model or pair-selection screen with news-embedding-derived ones.

bullets: 공간 수익률 모형은 연결 행렬을 그냥 주어진 값으로 받는다
기사 임베딩 분포를 바리센터로 재구성해 필드를 만든다
동일가중·RBF 가중보다 조건부 준우도가 높다
ko.data: 52개 종목의 뉴스 기사이며 2018-2022년 필드를 고정한 뒤 2023-2026년으로 검증한다.
ko.method: 종목별 언어모델 기사 임베딩 분포에 목표 고정 바서슈타인(Wasserstein) 바리센터 재구성을 적용하고, 이차 노출조정 문제로 피드백을 동종업체 정렬 오차 페널티 비율로 바꾼다.
ko.one_liner: 뉴스 임베딩 분포로 종목 간 연결 행렬을 직접 만든다.
ko.relevance_why: 종목 단위 뉴스 본문과 임베딩 파이프라인이 필요해 데이터 확보가 비싸고, 표본도 52개뿐이라 매매 규칙까지 가려면 설계가 많이 남는다.
ko.takeaway: 동종업체 가중치를 손으로 정하는 대신 뉴스 임베딩에서 뽑아 리스크 모형이나 페어 후보 선정에 넣어볼 만하다.

2608.29669.title: Wasserstein-Barycentric Interaction Fields for Spatial Factor Models: Evidence from Language-Model Representations

2608.29692.abstract: Portfolio risk assessment ordinarily relies on reliable estimates of cross-asset return covariances, which are difficult to obtain in short, high-dimensional panels. We show that firm-level distribution-valued characteristics can instead provide one-sided certificates of portfolio risk. Under maintained links from characteristics to systematic exposures and from exposures to returns, multi-firm Wasserstein-2 dispersion yields a sharp upper bound on systematic portfolio variance and a corresponding bound for standardized returns. A weighted pairwise relaxation produces an objective that is convex under a checkable condition and requires marginal volatility scales but no cross-asset return covariances. With zero firm-specific slack, the common-map scale changes the certified variance reduction but not the normalized allocation, which depends only on observed information geometry. In a 52-firm panel from 2018-2022, an allocation constructed from Qwen3-Embedding-8B news representations lies between the 0.69th and 1.33rd in-sample variance percentiles across four prespecified capped portfolio populations; equal risk weighting lies between the 21.1st and 28.6th percentiles. The lower in-sample variance ranking relative to equal risk also appears across the reported frozen language-model representations. The framework therefore distribution-valued firm information into a coherent risk bound and an implementable allocation rule constructed without cross-asset return covariances.

bullets: Short high-dimensional panels give unreliable covariance estimates
Wasserstein-2 dispersion across firms bounds systematic variance
A weighted pairwise relaxation makes the objective convex
In 52 firms, the allocation hit the 0.69th-1.33rd variance percentile
en.data: 52-firm panel, 2018-2022, with firm news text; evaluated by in-sample variance percentile against capped portfolio populations.
en.method: Treat firm news embeddings from Qwen3-Embedding-8B as distributions; multi-firm Wasserstein-2 dispersion caps systematic portfolio variance.
en.one_liner: Bounds portfolio variance from news embeddings, no cross-asset covariances.
en.relevance_why: News text and open embedding models are obtainable, but the paper gives no entry/exit rules and reports only in-sample variance ranks.
en.takeaway: Test it as a risk-parity substitute for baskets where return covariances are hard to estimate — small caps, recent IPOs.

bullets: 짧은 고차원 패널에서 자산 간 공분산 추정이 부정확하다
기업별 분포 특성의 Wasserstein-2 거리로 분산 상한을 유도한다
가중 쌍별 완화로 볼록 목적함수를 만들어 배분에 쓴다
52개 종목에서 표본 내 분산 백분위 0.69~1.33위를 기록했다
ko.data: 2018~2022년 52개 기업 패널과 종목별 뉴스 텍스트를 썼고 검증은 표본 내 분산 순위 비교다
ko.method: Qwen3-Embedding-8B가 만든 뉴스 표현을 분포값 특성으로 보고 다기업 Wasserstein-2 산포에서 체계적 분산의 상한을 유도한다
ko.one_liner: 뉴스 임베딩만으로 공분산 없이 포트폴리오 분산 상한을 잡는다
ko.relevance_why: 뉴스 텍스트와 오픈 임베딩 모델은 구하기 어렵지 않지만 진입·청산 규칙이 없고 표본 내 분산 순위만 보고해 배분 기법 수준에 머문다
ko.takeaway: 수익률 공분산 추정이 어려운 소형주나 신규 상장 종목 바스켓에서 위험균등(risk parity) 대신 쓸 배분 규칙으로 시험해볼 만하다

2608.29692.title: Portfolio Risk Bounds without Cross-Asset Return Covariances: Distributional Fields from Language-Model Representations

2608.30321.abstract: Loss-versus-Rebalancing (LVR) is the dominant adverse-selection cost borne by liquidity providers on automated market makers. Under geometric Brownian motion, arbitrage profit scales with the probability of a profitable block, which vanishes as the block time $Δt \to 0$; this is the standing argument for ever-shorter blocks. Modeling the reference price instead as a jump-diffusion, I show that the constant-product LVR rate splits into a diffusion channel carrying the known multiplier $F(γ/(σ\sqrt{Δt}))$ and a jump channel $λV \cdot G(γ;m,δ^2)$ carrying no $Δt$, the two interacting only through an explicitly bounded remainder. The block schedule therefore governs only one channel. For symmetric jump laws the jump channel is moreover an exact lower bound, $\ell(Δt) \ge λV G > 0$, so the rate does not vanish as $Δt \to 0$, and descends slowly, as $\sqrt{Δt}$. At Ethereum's calibrated 12-second slot the rate is 471 bp/yr against a floor of 125, so only three quarters of LP loss is schedule-addressable. At Solana's 400 ms slot the jump channel already dominates. Netting the rate against per-block consensus cost, the LP-side optimal block time is invariant in pool size and in every jump parameter $(λ,m,δ)$: jumps shift the level of LP loss but not the planner's marginal tradeoff. Volatility, the fee tier, and consensus cost set the optimum, near 8 s. However, LVR is only one input to block-time welfare, so this bounds the LP-side contribution rather than settling the design question.
2608.30321.comment: Extended version of a paper accepted at MARBLE 2026 (Lecture Notes in Operations Research, Springer); adds Appendix A with the full proofs of every numbered result and Appendix B with supporting illustrations. 25 pages, 2 figures

bullets: Kills the claim that Δt→0 drives LVR to zero
Splits constant-product LVR into diffusion and jump channels
Ethereum's 12s slot: 471 bp/yr, floor 125 bp/yr
LP-optimal block time sits near 8s, invariant to jump params
en.data: Theory only, with numbers calibrated to Ethereum's 12-second slot and Solana's 400 ms slot.
en.method: Models the reference price as a jump-diffusion, then separates the constant-product LVR rate into a Δt-dependent diffusion term F(γ/(σ√Δt)) and a Δt-free jump term λV·G(γ;m,δ²) with a bounded remainder.
en.one_liner: Jumps put a hard floor under AMM liquidity-provider losses that shorter blocks cannot remove.
en.relevance_why: It is a cost model, not an entry/exit rule, so building a strategy needs real design work; on-chain pool and block data are public, so sourcing is easy.
en.takeaway: Use the jump-channel floor as the irreducible adverse-selection cost when pricing whether pool fees cover LP risk.

bullets: 블록을 짧게 하면 LVR이 사라진다는 통념을 의심한다
기준가를 점프-확산으로 두고 LVR을 두 채널로 분해한다
이더리움 12초에서 471bp/yr 중 125bp는 바닥이다
LP 관점 최적 블록타임은 점프 모수와 무관하게 8초 근처다
ko.data: 이론 연구다. 다만 이더리움 12초 슬롯과 솔라나 400ms 슬롯에 모수를 맞춰 수치를 냈다
ko.method: 상수곱 AMM의 LVR을 점프-확산 기준가 아래에서 확산 채널 F(γ/(σ√Δt))와 점프 채널 λV·G(γ;m,δ²)로 분해하고 잔차를 명시적으로 상한 지었다
ko.one_liner: 점프를 넣으면 AMM 유동성 공급 손실에 없어지지 않는 바닥이 생긴다
ko.relevance_why: 매매 규칙이 아니라 LP 손익 모델의 부품이라 전략화에 설계가 더 필요하고 온체인 풀·블록 데이터는 공개라 확보 자체는 쉽다
ko.takeaway: LP 수익 모델에서 수수료 대비 역선택 비용을 잡을 때 블록타임으로 줄일 수 없는 손실 하한을 넣는 용도로 쓴다

2608.30321.title: Optimal Block Time for AMM Liquidity Providers under Jump-Diffusion Prices

2608.30446.abstract: Small-cap-inclusive equity universes contain recently listed and intermittently traded securities, so enforcing a common look-back discards a substantial fraction of the available information. Pairwise-complete estimation preserves the longest overlap for each asset pair, but the resulting correlation matrix can be indefinite because its entries are computed on different samples. This prevents direct use in Markowitz optimization and falls outside the assumptions of standard random-matrix shrinkage. We adapt a rotation-invariant neural covariance estimator to this setting. The model computes mask-aware marginal moments and a pairwise correlation matrix proxy, processes its signed spectrum, and uses a bidirectional gated recurrent unit conditioned on factor-aligned effective sample lengths derived from the overlap matrix and eigenvector loadings. It maps all eigenvalues, including negative ones, to a positive inverse spectrum. The reconstructed covariance is positive definite and is trained end-to-end to minimize five-day realized global-minimum-variance risk. We evaluate 26 expanding-window models from 2000 to 2025 on up to 1,500 U.S. equities in a closing-auction simulator with point-in-time selection, commissions, financing, corporate actions, and market impact. Across the 26-year out-of-sample period, the neural estimator reduces annualized five-day volatility by approximately 20\% and increases the Sharpe ratio by approximately 40\% relative to the next-best covariance estimator. These improvements are consistent across realized risk, risk-adjusted performance, and drawdown control, remain after the modeled execution frictions, and are supported by a 99.9\% Model Confidence Set that retains only the neural estimator.

bullets: Common look-backs throw away most small-cap history
Pairwise-complete matrices go indefinite, breaking Markowitz
Signed-spectrum GRU maps negative eigenvalues to positive ones
26-year OOS: vol down ~20%, Sharpe up ~40%
en.data: 26 expanding-window models, 2000-2025, up to 1,500 U.S. equities, in a closing-auction simulator with commissions, financing, corporate actions and market impact.
en.method: A rotation-invariant estimator feeds the signed spectrum of a pairwise correlation proxy through a bidirectional GRU conditioned on factor-aligned effective sample lengths, trained end-to-end on five-day realized GMV risk.
en.one_liner: A neural covariance estimator repairs indefinite pairwise correlation matrices for small-cap portfolios.
en.relevance_why: Daily U.S. equity prices are easy to source, but this is a risk model, not a signal, so you still design the strategy around it — hence 3.
en.takeaway: Drop it in as the covariance step when you want short-history and thinly traded names in the universe instead of screening them out.

bullets: 공통 관측구간을 강제하면 소형주 정보 상당수가 버려진다
쌍별 상관행렬은 부정부호라 마코위츠에 바로 못 넣는다
회전불변 신경 추정기가 음수 고유값까지 양수로 사상한다
26년 표본외에서 변동성 -20%, 샤프 +40%
ko.data: 2000~2025년 미국 주식 최대 1,500종목을 확장창 26개 모델로 나눠, 수수료·자금조달·기업행위·시장충격을 넣은 종가 단일가 체결 시뮬레이터에서 검증했다.

2608.30999.abstract: Market-order flow in financial markets exhibits long-range correlations. This is a widely known stylised fact of financial markets. A popular hypothesis for this stylised fact comes from the Lillo-Mike-Farmer (LMF) order-splitting theory. However, quantitative tests of this theory have historically relied on proprietary datasets with trader identifiers, limiting reproducibility and cross-market validation. We investigate whether it can be recovered from anonymous public data using synthetic metaorder reconstruction. Using transaction and quote data for the largest 239 stocks by market capitalisation on the JSE as of 13 March 2026 with the data range being 1 January 2023 until 31 December 2025, we conduct a grid search over reconstruction parameters and evaluate each configuration against established metaorder stylised facts and the LMF relation. Configurations selected to minimise errors across the metaorder impact stylised facts reproduce the targeted aggregate properties but yield a poor LMF relation. Configurations selected to minimise the LMF discrepancy recover the relation by construction while retaining several broad impact features, although some stock-level execution and decay fits are weaker. These asymmetric results show that recovering aggregate impact stylised facts alone is insufficient to identify LMF-consistent order splitting, while the LMF-targeted result establishes compatibility within the reconstruction class rather than an independent test. The findings support consistency with, rather than direct validation of, the LMF theory using anonymous market data.

bullets: LMF tests have needed proprietary data with trader IDs
Grid search over synthetic metaorder reconstruction rules
Impact-tuned configs fit stylised facts but break LMF
LMF-tuned configs recover the relation, weaker per-stock fits
en.data: Trade and quote data for the 239 largest JSE stocks by market cap (ranked 13 March 2026), covering 1 January 2023 to 31 December 2025.
en.method: Synthetic metaorder reconstruction from trades and quotes, with a grid search scored against metaorder stylised facts and the LMF relation.
en.one_liner: The authors rebuild metaorders from anonymous public trade data and test the LMF splitting theory.
en.relevance_why: Score 2: trade and quote data is purchasable but JSE tick data plus a reconstruction pipeline is a heavy lift, and the output is market-structure evidence, not a tradeable rule.
en.takeaway: Use the reconstruction rules to estimate how much of a large parent order is still working, but pick the tuning target deliberately — it changes the answer.

ms-economic-surprises-and-global-asset-c.abstract: Jupyter Notebook Quantamental economic surprises are deviations of economic indicators from estimated market expectations. The analysis is conducted both […] The post Economic surprises and global asset class returns appeared first on Macrosynergy .

bullets: Single-indicator surprises are too noisy to trade alone
Aggregates indicators into growth and inflation concepts
Tests rates, equity, FX, commodity and credit daily returns

ko.one_liner: 거시 지표로 자산배분 비중을 저빈도 조정하는 방법을 보인다.
ko.relevance_why: 규칙 골격은 재현 가능하나 팩터 정의와 임계값이 없고, 정제된 거시 시계열(Macrosynergy JPMaQS 등)은 유료라 확보가 쉽지 않다.
ko.takeaway: 멀티에셋 포트폴리오의 전술적 비중 오버레이 설계에 참고한다.

ms-wealth-management-with-macro-factors.title: Wealth management with macro factors

qc-aligrithm-crypto-isnt-structurally-al.abstract: Easley, O'Hara, Yang and Zhang take five textbook microstructure measures, compute them on Binance one-minute bars for BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL and ADA over January 2021 to July 2023, and ask a random forest to call the sign of tomorrow's change in the return distribution. Two numbers carry the

bullets: Tests whether crypto trades unlike equity markets
Uses five textbook microstructure measures on 1-min bars
Random forest calls the sign of tomorrow's shift
Roll, VPIN and Amihud carry most of the signal
en.data: Binance one-minute bars for BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL and ADA, January 2021 to July 2023.
en.method: A random forest classifies the sign of the next-day distribution change from five microstructure inputs.
en.one_liner: Microstructure measures predict next-day shifts in crypto return distributions.
en.relevance_why: Binance minute bars are free and the measures are standard, but a distribution-shift sign is a feature, not entry and exit rules — hence 3.
en.takeaway: Build Roll/VPIN/Amihud from minute bars as a volatility-regime filter or position-sizing input.

bullets: 암호화폐가 주식과 구조적으로 다른지 검증한다
롤 스프레드, VPIN, 아미후드 등 5개 지표를 쓴다
랜덤 포레스트로 다음날 분포 변화 방향을 맞춘다
롤, VPIN, 아미후드가 예측력의 대부분을 차지한다
ko.data: 바이낸스 1분봉 BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL, ADA를 2021년 1월부터 2023년 7월까지 쓴다.
ko.method: 교과서적 미시구조 지표 5개를 랜덤 포레스트에 넣어 분포 변화 부호를 분류한다.
ko.one_liner: 미시구조 지표로 암호화폐 수익률 분포 변화를 예측한다.
ko.relevance_why: 지표 계산법과 데이터가 모두 공개돼 재현은 쉽지만, 분포 변화 부호만으로는 매매 규칙이 안 나와 3점이다.
ko.takeaway: 1분봉으로 계산한 유동성, 정보성 주문흐름 지표를 변동성 레짐 필터나 포지션 사이징에 붙인다.

qc-aligrithm-crypto-isnt-structurally-al.title: Crypto Isn't Structurally Alien: Roll/VPIN/Amihud Predict Distribution Shifts

qc-aligrithm-fx-edge-lives-in-other-mark.abstract: A currency futures book built from other currency futures scores a Sharpe of 0.16. The same contracts, wired into a graph that also contains equities, bonds, and commodities, jump the FX sleeve to 0.66. That is Pu, Roberts, Dong, and Zohren, 64 futures, 2000 to 2022, volatility-targeted to 15%.

bullets: FX futures priced off FX futures alone earn 0.16 Sharpe
A graph adds equities, bonds, and commodities as nodes
The FX sleeve jumps to 0.66 Sharpe
en.data: 64 futures contracts, 2000 to 2022, volatility-targeted to 15%.
en.method: Pu, Roberts, Dong, and Zohren wire futures into a cross-asset graph model.
en.one_liner: Feeding other asset classes into an FX futures model quadruples its Sharpe.
en.relevance_why: Futures prices are easy to source, but the graph design and training setup are yours to build, so 3.
en.takeaway: Widen your FX feature set to include equity, bond, and commodity returns.

bullets: 통화 선물끼리만 보면 샤프가 0.16에 그친다
주식·채권·원자재를 한 그래프에 함께 넣는다
FX 슬리브 샤프가 0.66으로 뛴다
ko.data: 선물 64종의 2000~2022년 일별 시계열을 쓰고 변동성을 15%로 맞춘다
ko.method: 여러 자산군을 노드로 묶은 그래프 모형으로 통화 선물 포지션을 낸다
ko.one_liner: 타 자산군 정보를 엮어 FX 선물 수익을 네 배로 키웠다
ko.relevance_why: 선물 가격은 구하기 쉽지만 그래프 구조와 학습 설정을 직접 설계해야 해서 3점이다
ko.takeaway: FX 전략의 피처 집합에 주식·채권·원자재 수익률을 넣어 신호를 다시 뽑는다

qc-aligrithm-fx-edge-lives-in-other-mark.title: FX Edge Lives in Other Markets (cross-asset series)

qc-allocatesmartly-does-trading-taa-stra.abstract: Most Tactical Asset Allocation (TAA) strategies trade once per month. That’s by design. Short-term market movement is mostly noise, and trying to time every zig and zag is a fool’s errand. A unique feature of our platform is the ability to follow these monthly strategies on any day of the month.

bullets: Most TAA strategies trade once a month by design
Short-term moves are mostly noise, hard to time
Platform lets you run the same strategy on any day of the month
Tests whether higher trade frequency pays off
en.data: Abstract names no dataset or evaluation window.
en.method: Runs standard monthly TAA strategies while varying the trade day and rebalance frequency.
en.one_liner: Asks whether running monthly TAA strategies more frequently improves results.
en.relevance_why: The abstract gives no entry/exit rules to code directly, but the inputs are just daily ETF closes, so data is trivial to obtain.
en.takeaway: Useful for splitting a rebalance across multiple days to cut timing luck.

bullets: TAA 전략 대부분이 월말 하루에만 매매한다
단기 등락은 대부분 잡음이라 타이밍을 노리기 어렵다
월중 아무 날에나 같은 전략을 따라갈 수 있는 환경을 쓴다
매매 빈도를 올리는 게 득인지 실인지 검증한다
ko.data: 초록에 데이터셋과 검증 구간이 나오지 않는다.
ko.method: 월 1회 매매하는 TAA 전략을 매매일과 매매 빈도만 바꿔 비교한다.
ko.one_liner: 월 1회 리밸런싱 전략을 더 자주 돌리면 성과가 나아지는지 따진 글이다.
ko.relevance_why: TAA 전략 자체의 진입·청산 규칙이 초록에 없어 그대로 코딩할 수 없다. 다만 필요한 건 일별 ETF 종가뿐이라 데이터는 쉽게 구한다.
ko.takeaway: 리밸런싱 날짜를 여러 개로 쪼개 타이밍 운(timing luck)을 줄이는 데 참고할 만하다.

qc-allocatesmartly-does-trading-taa-stra.title: Does Trading TAA Strategies More Often Improve Performance?

qc-blog-sec-form-4-insider-trading-pytho.abstract: Form 4 looks unusually convenient for quantitative research. It is public, structured and tied to a regulatory deadline: in general, a reporting person must file by the end of the second business day after a reportable transaction. The SEC's Form 4 instructions state the rule and also show why

bullets: Tests whether insider filings carry tradable information
Anchors the event on the filing date, not the trade date
SEC allows two business days to file, creating a lag
Abstract reports no return numbers
en.data: SEC Form 4 filings from EDGAR; the abstract names no evaluation window.
en.method: Parses Form 4 filings in Python, then runs an event study around the filing date.
en.one_liner: Runs a filing-date event study on SEC Form 4 insider trades in Python.
en.relevance_why: Form 4 is free on EDGAR but needs heavy XML parsing and cleaning, and the abstract gives no entry rules or performance numbers.
en.takeaway: Time any insider-buying signal off the filing timestamp, since the trade date is stale by up to two days.

bullets: 내부자 거래 공시가 정말 알파를 주는지 확인한다
거래일이 아닌 신고일을 기준점으로 잡는다
SEC가 정한 2영업일 신고 마감이 시차를 만든다
초록만으로는 구체적 수익률 결과를 알 수 없다
ko.data: SEC EDGAR의 Form 4 공시 데이터를 쓰며, 검증 구간은 초록에 없다.
ko.method: Form 4 공시를 파이썬으로 수집해 신고일 기준 이벤트 스터디를 돌린다.
ko.one_liner: Form 4 내부자 거래 공시를 신고일 기준 이벤트 스터디로 분석한다.
ko.relevance_why: Form 4는 EDGAR에서 무료로 받지만 XML 파싱과 정제 부담이 크고, 초록에 매매 규칙이나 성과 수치가 없어 2점이다.
ko.takeaway: 내부자 매수 신호를 만들 때 거래일 대신 신고일을 기준으로 잡는 게 핵심이다.

qc-blog-sec-form-4-insider-trading-pytho.title: Form 4 Insider Trading in Python: A Filing-Date Event Study

qc-equibles-what-happens-after-congress-.abstract: The obvious rule is to buy what members of Congress buy and avoid, or short, what they sell. Across 17,859 investable common-stock disclosure events, that rule fails. One year after a disclosure became public, the typical purchase event trailed the S&P 500 by 5.36 percentage points and the

bullets: Tests the popular rule: buy what Congress buys
Studies 17,859 investable common-stock disclosure events
Purchases trail the S&P 500 by 5.36pp one year after disclosure
en.data: 17,859 investable common-stock disclosure events, each tracked for one year post-disclosure.
en.method: Event study measuring one-year excess return from the date each disclosure went public.
en.one_liner: Copying congressional stock purchases underperforms the S&P 500.
en.relevance_why: Score 3: disclosure data is free and public, but the abstract gives no sell-side numbers, universe filter, or rebalancing rule, so a tradable version needs real design work.
en.takeaway: Drop congressional-buy copying from the signal set, or test it as a fade.

bullets: 의원 따라 사기 전략이 정말 통하는지 검증한다
투자 가능한 보통주 공시 17,859건을 이벤트로 분석한다
공시 1년 뒤 매수 이벤트는 S&P 500을 5.36%p 하회한다
ko.data: 투자 가능한 보통주 공시 17,859건을 쓰고, 공시 후 1년을 평가 구간으로 잡는다.
ko.method: 공시 공개일을 기준으로 삼아 1년 초과수익을 재는 이벤트 스터디다.
ko.one_liner: 의회 의원 매매를 따라 사는 전략이 실패함을 보인다.
ko.relevance_why: 규칙 자체는 단순하나 초록에 매도 결과와 리밸런싱 규칙이 없고, 공시 데이터는 무료 공개라 확보는 쉽다.
ko.takeaway: 의원 매수 추종 시그널을 알파 소스에서 빼거나 역방향 근거로 쓴다.

qc-equibles-what-happens-after-congress-.title: What Happens After Congress Buys or Sells a Stock? Evidence...

qc-miktul-dual-momentum-for-a-collapsing.abstract: Turkish savers have argued about the same question for decades: keep the money in a lira time deposit and collect the interest, or convert it to dollars and hold. The dilemma is common enough to have a household name — faiz mi, dolar mı?, “interest or dollars?” Both answers have had long

bullets: Targets the Turkish saver's 'interest or dollars?' dilemma
Switches between the two instead of picking one
Both choices had long winning stretches historically
Tests allocation rules under a collapsing currency
en.data: Turkish lira deposit rates and USD/TRY over a long history; the abstract names no window.
en.method: Dual momentum allocation across two assets: lira time deposits and long USD.
en.one_liner: Applies dual momentum to the lira-deposit versus dollar choice.
en.relevance_why: Deposit rates and FX rates are public and easy to source, but the abstract leaves lookback and rebalance parameters unspecified, so 4.
en.takeaway: A switching rule for cash versus hard currency in high-inflation markets.

bullets: 터키 저축자의 오랜 고민, '이자냐 달러냐'를 다룬다
둘 중 하나를 고르는 대신 모멘텀 규칙으로 갈아탄다
두 선택지 모두 오래 우세한 구간이 있었다
통화가 무너지는 환경에서 배분 규칙을 검증한다
ko.data: 터키 리라 예금 금리와 달러/리라 환율의 장기 시계열을 쓴다. 초록에 구체적 구간은 없다
ko.method: 리라 정기예금과 달러 보유를 후보로 놓고 듀얼 모멘텀(dual momentum) 방식으로 배분한다
ko.one_liner: 리라 예금과 달러 보유 중 무엇이 나은지 듀얼 모멘텀으로 답한다
ko.relevance_why: 예금 금리와 환율은 공개 데이터라 확보가 쉽고 규칙도 명확하지만 초록만으로는 룩백 기간 같은 파라미터를 알 수 없어 4점이다
ko.takeaway: 고인플레 통화권에서 현금성 자산과 달러 사이를 모멘텀으로 스위칭하는 규칙에 쓴다

qc-miktul-dual-momentum-for-a-collapsing.title: Dual Momentum for a Collapsing Currency

qc-quantbeckman-from-market-problems-to-.abstract: In this episode of House of Quants, listeners will discover: Why quantitative trading is engineering: The episode challenges the myth of the lone trader searching for magical chart patterns and explains how institutional research operates as an industrial-scale system built around data, statistics,

bullets: Attacks the myth of the lone trader reading charts
Describes institutional research as an industrial system
Names data and statistics as that system's core
Offers no strategy, no numbers, no backtest
en.data: theory only
en.method: Conversational episode; no model, no technique.
en.one_liner: A podcast episode argues quant trading is engineering, not pattern hunting.
en.relevance_why: No rules and no dataset to source, so there is nothing to automate.
en.takeaway: Useful only as framing when you design a research process or team.

bullets: 차트 패턴을 찾는 고독한 트레이더 신화를 비판한다
기관 리서치가 산업적 시스템으로 돌아간다고 설명한다
데이터와 통계가 그 시스템의 축이라고 짚는다
구체적 전략이나 실증 결과는 담겨 있지 않다
ko.data: 이론 연구
ko.method: 모델이나 기법 없이 대담 형식으로 관점을 전달한다.
ko.one_liner: 퀀트 트레이딩을 공학으로 보는 팟캐스트 대담이다.
ko.relevance_why: 매매 규칙도 데이터도 없어 자동화할 대상이 전혀 없다.
ko.takeaway: 리서치 조직 구성이나 프로세스 설계를 고민할 때 참고할 만하다.

qc-quantbeckman-from-market-problems-to-.title: Podcast: From market problems to quantitative trading systems

qc-quanterlab-one-half-of-the-magic-form.abstract: Joel Greenblatt's Magic Formula ranks companies on two numbers and buys the ones that score well on both. One asks whether a business is cheap. The other asks whether it is any good. The claim in the book is that the pair works better than either number on its own. We tested that claim by

bullets: Greenblatt claims cheap plus good beats either half
Authors rank stocks on each metric separately
Quality-only ranking outperformed the combination
Adding the value leg dragged returns down
en.data: Abstract names no dataset or test window.
en.method: Rank stocks on earnings yield and return on capital separately, then race each against the combined rank.
en.one_liner: Splitting the Magic Formula in two, quality alone beat the combined rank.
en.relevance_why: Fully reproducible from public filings data, but the abstract leaves universe and rebalance cadence to you; +1 for refuting a popular retail strategy.
en.takeaway: Drop or down-weight the cheapness leg and screen on the quality metric alone.

bullets: 그린블라트는 저평가와 퀄리티 결합이 낫다고 주장한다
두 지표를 따로 돌려 결합 순위와 성과를 맞붙였다
퀄리티 단독 순위가 결합 순위를 앞섰다
밸류를 섞는 행위가 오히려 성과를 깎았다
ko.data: 초록에 데이터셋과 검증 구간을 밝히지 않았다
ko.method: 수익률(earnings yield)과 자본수익률(ROC)로 각각 순위를 매겨 결합 순위와 비교한다
ko.one_liner: 매직 포뮬러를 두 축으로 쪼개 검증하니 퀄리티 단독이 더 좋았다
ko.relevance_why: 재무제표만 있으면 그대로 재현하는 규칙이라 데이터 확보가 쉽지만, 유니버스와 리밸런싱 주기는 직접 정해야 한다
ko.takeaway: 퀄리티 지표만으로 랭킹을 짜고 밸류 가중치는 낮추거나 빼는 편이 낫다

qc-quanterlab-one-half-of-the-magic-form.title: Magic Formula tested against each half: quality alone beat the combination

qc-quanterlab-the-crash-switch-worked-an.abstract: In July 2022 Wouter Keller published Bold Asset Allocation. This paper walks the aggressive variant, BAA-G4: hold the single strongest of QQQ, VWO, VEA and BND by relative momentum, or retreat into bonds and bills when a canary basket says so. We ran the published rules on the real tradable funds

bullets: Published TAA rules often break on actual funds
Canary basket flips the book from risk to bonds
Holds one of QQQ, VWO, VEA, BND by momentum
Crash protection fired; returns still starved
en.data: Real tradable funds including QQQ, VWO, VEA and BND; the abstract names no test window.
en.method: Relative momentum picks the single strongest offense asset; a canary basket forces a retreat into bonds and bills.
en.one_liner: Quanter Lab replays Keller's aggressive BAA-G4 on real tradable ETFs.
en.relevance_why: Rules are public and need only daily ETF prices, so data is trivial to source and the backtest runs as written.
en.takeaway: Borrow the canary switch as a defensive overlay, but verify its return drag before trading it.

bullets: 논문 규칙과 실거래 ETF 성과가 다를 수 있다
카나리아 신호로 위험자산과 채권을 오간다
QQQ·VWO·VEA·BND 중 최강 1종만 보유한다
폭락 회피는 됐지만 수익은 굶주렸다
ko.data: QQQ, VWO, VEA, BND 등 실제 거래 가능한 ETF 가격을 쓰지만 검증 구간은 초록에 없다.
ko.method: 상대 모멘텀으로 공격 자산 1종을 고르고, 카나리아 바스켓이 경고하면 채권과 단기채로 대피한다.
ko.one_liner: 켈러의 공격형 BAA-G4를 실제 ETF로 재현해 검증한다.
ko.relevance_why: 규칙이 공개돼 있고 ETF 일별 가격만 있으면 그대로 백테스트할 수 있어 데이터 확보가 쉽다.
ko.takeaway: 월간 리밸런싱 TAA 전략의 방어 스위치 설계 참고용으로 쓰고, 수익 기여도는 따로 검증한다.

qc-quanterlab-the-crash-switch-worked-an.title: The Crash Switch Worked and the Strategy Starved Anyway: Keller's Menu Tested

qc-spatium-novum-five-hundred-years-of-d.abstract: Markowitz's 1952 paper deliberately begins after investors have formed beliefs about future returns. Portfolio choice is the second stage; estimating its inputs is the first. Rebuilding Robert Shiller's three-asset classroom example with two defensible US equity series moves the

bullets: Markowitz starts after beliefs form, skipping input estimation
Rebuilds Shiller's three-asset example on US equity series
Changing the inputs shifts the optimal weights sharply
en.data: Two defensible US equity return series; the abstract names no evaluation window.
en.method: Classic mean-variance optimization re-run on a textbook example to test input sensitivity.
en.one_liner: Shows how estimation error breaks Markowitz optimization in practice.
en.relevance_why: US equity index data is trivial to source, but the paper gives no tradable rules.
en.takeaway: Benchmark any optimizer output against 1/N before trusting its weights.

bullets: 마코위츠는 기대수익 추정 단계를 아예 건너뛴다

qp-boundaries-of-time-series-momentum.abstract: Time-series momentum stands as one of the most reliable and heavily backtested anomalies in quantitative finance, serving as a foundational alpha source for modern managed futures and trend-following strategies. However, a recent academic paper by Matti Suominen and Erik Hjalmarsson, titled "Boundaries of Time Series Momentum," uncovers a structural vulnerability that every practitioner must account for. The authors demonstrate that while equity market trends persist reliably during normal business cycles, they systematically break down and aggressively reverse when market valuations reach historical extremes. This phenomenon establishes clear macro "boundaries" where chasing the trend shifts from a highly profitable strategy to a severe drawdown risk.

bullets: Practitioners treat trend following as an all-weather alpha
The authors split history by market valuation level
Equity trends persist in normal cycles, reverse at extremes
Result: a macro boundary that flips trend into drawdown risk
en.data: The abstract names no dataset or evaluation window.
en.method: Condition time-series momentum returns on the level of market valuation.
en.one_liner: Suominen and Hjalmarsson show time-series momentum fails at valuation extremes.
en.relevance_why: Valuation metrics and index prices are free and public, but you must set the thresholds and exit rules yourself.
en.takeaway: Use a valuation regime filter to cut equity trend exposure when valuations hit historical extremes.

ko.takeaway: 밸류에이션이 역사적 극단에 닿으면 주식 추세 포지션 비중을 줄이는 필터로 쓴다.
